title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Courtesy Bonus Award by Comfort Club Dues Payment Method
content:
How a courtesy-program customer has paid Comfort Club dues earns a courtesy bonus award toward the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The records read are the dues payment entries on the dues ledger of the customer's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, with their payment method and posting date.

**Rule.** A customer whose active agreement's dues were paid by card on file at least once in the last 12 months earns a courtesy bonus award of 2 points. One whose active agreement's dues were paid only by other means in that time earns 1 point. Any other customer earns no award.

| Active agreement: dues payments in the last 12 months | Courtesy bonus award |
|---|---|
| At least one by card on file | 2 points |
| Only by other means (bank autopay, card by phone or check) | 1 point |
| No active agreement | None |

## Example (hypothetical)

A member who pays dues by bank autopay but paid one month by card on file earns 2 points. A member who paid every month by bank autopay earns 1 point.
